title: Architecture decision record (ADR)
description: A single architecture decision in the ADR-0001 narrative format (doc 11 §6). Canonical form: one markdown file per decision (adr-NNNN.md) — YAML frontmatter (envelope + a `data:` block) plus the required context / decision / consequences sections. Tier A: cite the REQ/CMP items the decision rules on through links.realizes (corpus-checked at the gate per T1/T3, not by this schema). Validates the {meta, data, sections} projection (doc 11 §5).

type.description: Selects this schema; MUST be the literal string `architecture-decision`.

id.description: Document id for this decision: `adr-NNNN` with a zero-padded four-digit serial, e.g. adr-0011. Architecture-decisions is a multi-instance type — one file per decision (doc 11 §3, §6).

deciders.description: The people and/or agents who made this decision. List every party with authority over the ruling; at least one is required.

items.description: One decider — a human name or an agent/run identifier.

context.description: Markdown. The forces at play: the problem, the constraints, and the requirements (REQ) or components (CMP) under pressure that make a decision necessary. State the situation neutrally — what is true and in tension before any choice is made.

decision.description: Markdown. The ruling itself, stated in active voice ("We will …"). Name the option chosen and, briefly, the alternatives rejected and why. This is what the architecture commits to; the REQ/CMP items it rules on belong in links.realizes.

consequences.description: Markdown. What becomes easier and what becomes harder once this decision is in force — the trade-offs accepted, follow-on work created, and risks taken on. Record both positive and negative consequences.
